title: Fig Pours Too Much
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.

pages.text: Fig sees the gardener feed the plants.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar on a leaf, watching a watering can tip gently over the window box plants.
Fig the caterpillar standing beside a small green watering can, looking eager to help.

pages.text: Fig pours too much on the plants.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar tipping the small watering can right over, a big stream of water pouring onto the window box.

pages.text: The window box gets too wet.
pages.illustration: Water pooling and dripping over the edge of the window box, soaking the soil.
The green plant shoots in the window box drooping over, heavy with too much water.

pages.text: Fig feels bad about the mess.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar looking at the drooping shoots, antennae lowered, looking sorry.

pages.text: Fig asks Nell what to do.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar turning to Nell the bee, who is hovering nearby by the window box.
Nell the bee hovering close to the small watering can, pointing a leg at it.

pages.text: Fig pours just a little bit.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar tipping the watering can carefully, just a small trickle landing on the soil.
The green plant shoots in the window box standing upright again, perky in the sunshine.
